limits: Four fixed real scenes and 17 fixed views per run are a bounded control, not every scene/device.
Baseline lacks a saved-object edit UI; its recording demonstrates absence and does not fabricate a prior editing workflow.
Phone uses native touch for editing only; no touch-driving capability is claimed. Actual keyboard drive/contact/reset is desktop-only.

Successful recompile carries unchanged objects’ qpos/control while applying the target edit; Undo restores descriptor/order/poses. Both clear velocities and restart time. Cancel/refusals paused without stepping preserve full state.
Raw full scene payloads are retained. Only the new object_edit metadata field is omitted for rendering-payload comparison; its transfer/parse costs remain measured.
Fresh profiles do not erase machine/driver caches. RSS sums process trees and may count shared pages repeatedly; it is not GPU VRAM.
Two cohorts per source do not establish a general performance win or a statistical upper bound. Render samples are synchronous draw+readback costs, RAF is separate.
Full uncapped timestamped videos are decoded in full. Decoded stills and a contact excerpt supplement, rather than replace, complete workflows.
The initial5s drive trial stopped before contact (roverx+.028, wallx.6);8s native input reaches real contact. All failures and earlier captures are retained.

quick-v1 failed an overly strict helper assertion requiring full integration-history restoration after Undo. The corrected contract and raw qvel/time values are retained; this was a helper failure, not an observed source regression.
The first contact-camera supplement retained a follow-target offset that put rover at frame edge. The final supplementary camera starts centered on rover and follows naturally.
This worker verifies scoped journeys/visual controls/media, not the whole app test suite, installed wheel, or global HTTP budget; root runs those separately.

Preceding full-v2 journeys retain actual actions/state/video but omitted received WS payloads. Separate fresh full-v3 desktop/phone receipt supplements now preserve original sent/received frames and independently matched request/reply IDs. These are separate reruns, not reconstructed acknowledgments for the preceding videos. The original fixed A1/B1/A2/B2 cohorts are unchanged.

idle_ab.definition: Same existing bench._cold_start + five-second _cpu_share; one frozen saved dog world, four serial fresh server processes; shared Chrome profile/cache, order A1/B1/A2/B2. Not statistical bounds. No budget relaxation. A single full budget repeat is predeclared after this diagnostic regardless of result.

idle_abba_diagnostic.definition: One fixed A/B/B/A batch,30seconds each, original first5s retained, later5s slices not used as replacement budget. Same standingdog/same browserprofile, instrumented equally for GC/scene/version/advance counts. CPU samples use existing ps time granularity, both nominal5s and actualwall divided rates retained. Not a new passing budget.
